summary: The levitating sack has no screen or cursor difference, but the C trace at step 86 draws rn2(100) in zap.c:obj_resists for a glass item inside the impacted container. JS do.js skips the void dokick.c:container_impact_dmg call and records a gap, so its next draw is rn2(5). Port that whole source function and wire its drop, throw, and kick callers; preserve object destruction, luck, shop cost, and weight updates.

source.branch: container_impact_dmg: a normal floor container with contents is impacted by the hero; for each glass non-gem child C calls obj_resists(child,33,100) before any later drop or turn-loop RNG.
callers: do.c:dropz calls container_impact_dmg after place_object for a floating hero
dothrow.c:drop_throw calls container_impact_dmg for thrown containers
dokick.c:really_kick_object calls container_impact_dmg for a kicked box
js/do.js:dropz currently notes and skips the void call
dependencies: zap.c:obj_resists is ported in js/bury.js and must receive 33,100 with source RNG order
shk.c:stolen_value is ported and returns shop loss; other shop helpers need source review
Object extraction, useup, obfree, weight, and luck helpers must be checked for source behavior; make_angry_shk may remain an explicit void gap if unported

evidence: C dokick.c:412-484 skips non-containers, empty containers and magic bags; for each child it tests glass/non-gem then calls obj_resists(33,100), otherwise tests egg rn2(3). A broken child changes luck, emits the muffled sound/message, accounts for shop loss, consumes/removes the child, clears cknown and recomputes weight.

C do.c:831, dothrow.c:1830 and dokick.c:655 call container_impact_dmg and discard its return. JS js/do.js:1759-1767 identifies a content-bearing ordinary container but only calls note_unported, leaving all of the source RNG and effects skipped.

The v12 saved evaluation matches all 87 screens and cursors, but its first RNG difference is at zero-based step 86: C `rn2(100)=89` from obj_resists(zap.c:1469), JS next `rn2(5)=4`. It has 0 remaining screens but is still unmatched by the challenge evaluator.

JS js/bury.js:97 implements obj_resists; the source task should call that shared implementation instead of synthesizing the recorded draw. The recipe and recording are challenges/cases/v12/levitating-sack-impact-keeps-content.*.session.json.
